entries.title: Your phone and other computers catch up after a short break more often
entries.body: While crewmates work, your computer no longer counts each word they write or each step they take among the recent changes it keeps for your other devices. A phone or another computer that drops for a few minutes now more often catches up on just what it missed instead of reading everything again, and your phone is no longer sent crewmate activity it never shows.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes; a device that comes back reads less before it is up to date.
